title: 長距離輸水管水錘分析
titleEn: Water-hammer analysis for long water mains
subcategoryTitle: 輸配水、河川與都市防洪
subcategoryTitleEn: Water conveyance, rivers and urban flood protection
summary: 本課從穩態水頭線開始，依序分析彈性波速、速度突變、邊界反射、關閉曲線及停泵慣性，再把低壓空穴、氣室熱力、數值網格與疲勞接回完整輸水系統。每個算例都分清初步量級與完整瞬變模型，並要求壓力、流量、閥位及時間基準互相驗證。
summaryEn: Starting with the steady hydraulic grade, this course examines elastic wave speed, velocity changes, reflections, closure shape and pump inertia, then connects cavities, air-vessel thermodynamics, numerical grids and fatigue to the complete water-main system. Each example distinguishes a scale estimate from a complete transient model and checks pressure, flow, valve position and timing against one another.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「穩態水頭基線機理與驗證」與「流體管壁耦合波速機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Steady hydraulic baseline mechanism and verification" and "Fluid and wall wave speed mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 穩態水頭基線機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Steady hydraulic baseline mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「穩態水頭基線」如何影響長距離輸水管水錘分析的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Steady hydraulic baseline” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Water-hammer analysis for long water mains”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水錘計算的初始狀態必須同時滿足水量與能量守恆，不能任意指定互不相容的流量及兩端水位。長管摩阻、局部閥損與泵揚程共同決定速度，而高程圖決定每處壓力水頭；相同總壓降並不表示沿線最低壓位置相同。本單元的達西公式假設滿管單相穩定流，所給摩阻係數已另行確定；它不能描述壓力波到達前後的瞬間局部加速度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「穩態水頭基線」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A transient calculation needs an initial state satisfying both continuity and energy balance. Flow and boundary levels cannot be chosen independently when they are incompatible. Distributed friction, local valve losses and pump head determine velocity, while the elevation profile determines pressure head at each location. Equal total head loss does not imply the same location of minimum pressure. The Darcy example assumes steady, single-phase full-pipe flow with a separately established friction factor. It does not describe local acceleration as a pressure wave arrives. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Steady hydraulic baseline” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設L=5000 m、D=1 m、v=2 m/s、f=0.020、g=9.81 m/s²，hf=f(L/D)v²/(2g)=20.39 m，未含局部損失。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume L=5000 m, D=1 m, v=2 m/s, f=0.020 and g=9.81 m/s²; hf=f(L/D)v²/(2g)=20.39 m, excluding local losses.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要知道平均流量，就不必核對沿線高程與壓力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Knowing average flow removes the need to check elevation and pressure." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「穩態水頭基線」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Steady hydraulic baseline”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 穩態水頭基線機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Steady hydraulic baseline mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 水錘計算的初始狀態必須同時滿足水量與能量守恆，不能任意指定互不相容的流量及兩端水位。長管摩阻、局部閥損與泵揚程共同決定速度，而高程圖決定每處壓力水頭；相同總壓降並不表示沿線最低壓位置相同。
knowledge.textEn: A transient calculation needs an initial state satisfying both continuity and energy balance. Flow and boundary levels cannot be chosen independently when they are incompatible.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要知道平均流量，就不必核對沿線高程與壓力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Knowing average flow removes the need to check elevation and pressure. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「穩態水頭基線機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Steady hydraulic baseline mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 只要知道平均流量，就不必核對沿線高程與壓力。
水錘計算的初始狀態必須同時滿足水量與能量守恆，不能任意指定互不相容的流量及兩端水位。
水錘波速永遠等於水中聲速且與管壁無關。
optionsEn: Knowing average flow removes the need to check elevation and pressure.
A transient calculation needs an initial state satisfying both continuity and energy balance.
Water-hammer speed always equals water sound speed regardless of the wall.
quiz.explanation: 水錘計算的初始狀態必須同時滿足水量與能量守恆，不能任意指定互不相容的流量及兩端水位。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A transient calculation needs an initial state satisfying both continuity and energy balance. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 穩態水頭基線機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Steady hydraulic baseline mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「穩態水頭基線」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Steady hydraulic baseline” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設L=5000 m、D=1 m、v=2 m/s、f=0.020、g=9.81 m/s²，hf=f(L/D)v²/(2g)=20.39 m，未含局部損失。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume L=5000 m, D=1 m, v=2 m/s, f=0.020 and g=9.81 m/s²; hf=f(L/D)v²/(2g)=20.39 m, excluding local losses. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將同步流量、上游水位與下游壓力換算到同一高程基準，逐段對照管徑及粗糙度，另列閥門局部損失。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Convert synchronized flow, upstream level and downstream pressure to one elevation datum, checking diameter and roughness segment by segment and listing valve losses separately.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設L=5000 m、D=1 m、v=2 m/s、f=0.020、g=9.81 m/s²，hf=f(L/D)v²/(2g)=20.39 m，未含局部損失。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume L=5000 m, D=1 m, v=2 m/s, f=0.020 and g=9.81 m/s²; hf=f(L/D)v²/(2g)=20.39 m, excluding local losses.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「穩態水頭基線機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Steady hydraulic baseline mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 管線長度相同就必定具有相同反射歷程。
初始轉動能除以額定功率就是精確停泵時間。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設L=5000 m、D=1 m、v=2 m/s、f=0.020、g=9.81 m/s²，hf=f(L/D)v²/(2g)=20.39 m，未含局部損失。
optionsEn: Equal pipeline lengths necessarily produce identical reflection histories.
Initial rotational energy divided by rated power gives exact rundown time.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume L=5000 m, D=1 m, v=2 m/s, f=0.020 and g=9.81 m/s².
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設L=5000 m、D=1 m、v=2 m/s、f=0.020、g=9.81 m/s²，hf=f(L/D)v²/(2g)=20.39 m，未含局部損失。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume L=5000 m, D=1 m, v=2 m/s, f=0.020 and g=9.81 m/s²; hf=f(L/D)v²/(2g)=20.39 m, excluding local losses. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 穩態水頭基線機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Steady hydraulic baseline mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「穩態水頭基線」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Steady hydraulic baseline” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將同步流量、上游水位與下游壓力換算到同一高程基準，逐段對照管徑及粗糙度，另列閥門局部損失。先用未參與校準的穩態時段驗證水頭線，再將可信初值交給瞬變模型。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Convert synchronized flow, upstream level and downstream pressure to one elevation datum, checking diameter and roughness segment by segment and listing valve losses separately. Validate the hydraulic grade using a steady period withheld from calibration before transferring initial conditions to the transient model. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：建立一張包含流量、基準高程及損失項的能量帳，標示哪些資料為量測、哪些為假設；要求相鄰管段交界的水頭與流量相容後才比較瞬變情境。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare an energy ledger containing flow, datum and losses, marking measured and assumed quantities. Require compatible head and flow at adjacent pipe interfaces before comparing transient scenarios.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若初始水頭線不閉合，數值模型可能在尚未操作閥門前就產生人造波動；這種啟動誤差會被誤判成管線反射或真實水錘。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An inconsistent initial hydraulic grade can create artificial oscillations before any valve action. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將同步流量、上游水位與下游壓力換算到同一高程基準，逐段對照管徑及粗糙度，另列閥門局部損失。先用未參與校準的穩態時段驗證水頭線，再將可信初值交給瞬變模型。
knowledge.textEn: Convert synchronized flow, upstream level and downstream pressure to one elevation datum, checking diameter and roughness segment by segment and listing valve losses separately. Validate the hydraulic grade using a steady period withheld from calibration before transferring initial conditions to the transient model.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 建立一張包含流量、基準高程及損失項的能量帳，標示哪些資料為量測、哪些為假設；要求相鄰管段交界的水頭與流量相容後才比較瞬變情境。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare an energy ledger containing flow, datum and losses, marking measured and assumed quantities. Require compatible head and flow at adjacent pipe interfaces before comparing transient scenarios.

quiz.question: 要驗證「穩態水頭基線機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Steady hydraulic baseline mechanism and verification"?
options: 將同步流量、上游水位與下游壓力換算到同一高程基準，逐段對照管徑及粗糙度，另列閥門局部損失。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
調壓氣室的總容積等於任何時刻可用的氣體容積。
optionsEn: Convert synchronized flow, upstream level and downstream pressure to one elevation datum, checking diameter and roughness segment by segment and listing valve losses separately.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Total vessel volume equals usable gas volume at every instant.
quiz.explanation: 將同步流量、上游水位與下游壓力換算到同一高程基準，逐段對照管徑及粗糙度，另列閥門局部損失。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Convert synchronized flow, upstream level and downstream pressure to one elevation datum, checking diameter and roughness segment by segment and listing valve losses separately. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 穩態水頭基線機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Steady hydraulic baseline mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「穩態水頭基線」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Steady hydraulic baseline” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若初始水頭線不閉合，數值模型可能在尚未操作閥門前就產生人造波動；這種啟動誤差會被誤判成管線反射或真實水錘。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An inconsistent initial hydraulic grade can create artificial oscillations before any valve action. Such startup errors may then be misidentified as physical reflections or actual water hammer. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本單元的達西公式假設滿管單相穩定流，所給摩阻係數已另行確定；它不能描述壓力波到達前後的瞬間局部加速度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: It does not describe local acceleration as a pressure wave arrives.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要知道平均流量，就不必核對沿線高程與壓力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Knowing average flow removes the need to check elevation and pressure." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若初始水頭線不閉合，數值模型可能在尚未操作閥門前就產生人造波動；這種啟動誤差會被誤判成管線反射或真實水錘。
knowledge.textEn: An inconsistent initial hydraulic grade can create artificial oscillations before any valve action. Such startup errors may then be misidentified as physical reflections or actual water hammer.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「穩態水頭基線機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Steady hydraulic baseline mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若初始水頭線不閉合，數值模型可能在尚未操作閥門前就產生人造波動；這種啟動誤差會被誤判成管線反射或真實水錘。
水錘波速永遠等於水中聲速且與管壁無關。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
An inconsistent initial hydraulic grade can create artificial oscillations before any valve action.
Water-hammer speed always equals water sound speed regardless of the wall.
quiz.explanation: 若初始水頭線不閉合，數值模型可能在尚未操作閥門前就產生人造波動；這種啟動誤差會被誤判成管線反射或真實水錘。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An inconsistent initial hydraulic grade can create artificial oscillations before any valve action. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 流體管壁耦合波速機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Fluid and wall wave speed mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「流體管壁耦合波速」如何影響長距離輸水管水錘分析的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fluid and wall wave speed” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Water-hammer analysis for long water mains”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 壓力波速度由水的可壓縮性與管壁徑向柔度共同控制，不能直接使用自由水體的聲速。薄壁鋼管的直徑厚度比越大，壁面變形通常越明顯；錨定、泊松效應、襯層及含氣量則會改變有效柔度和頻散，需與管材模型一起選定。下式為忽略泊松與端部約束修正的簡化彈性薄壁關係，不能直接套用黏彈性塑膠管或有大氣囊的管路。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「流體管壁耦合波速」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Pressure-wave speed depends jointly on water compressibility and radial pipe-wall compliance, so the sound speed in unconfined water is insufficient. A larger diameter-to-thickness ratio generally increases thin steel-wall deformation. Restraint, Poisson coupling, linings and entrained air change effective compliance and dispersion, requiring a wave-speed model consistent with pipe material and installation. The expression is a simplified thin elastic-wall relation without Poisson or end-restraint corrections. It does not directly represent viscoelastic plastic pipes or large trapped-air pockets. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Fluid and wall wave speed” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

knowledge.title: 流體管壁耦合波速機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Fluid and wall wave speed mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 壓力波速度由水的可壓縮性與管壁徑向柔度共同控制，不能直接使用自由水體的聲速。薄壁鋼管的直徑厚度比越大，壁面變形通常越明顯；錨定、泊松效應、襯層及含氣量則會改變有效柔度和頻散，需與管材模型一起選定。
knowledge.textEn: Pressure-wave speed depends jointly on water compressibility and radial pipe-wall compliance, so the sound speed in unconfined water is insufficient. A larger diameter-to-thickness ratio generally increases thin steel-wall deformation.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：水錘波速永遠等於水中聲速且與管壁無關。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Water-hammer speed always equals water sound speed regardless of the wall. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「流體管壁耦合波速機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Fluid and wall wave speed mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 水錘波速永遠等於水中聲速且與管壁無關。
焦可夫斯基壓升就是全線的絕對最大壓力。
壓力波速度由水的可壓縮性與管壁徑向柔度共同控制，不能直接使用自由水體的聲速。
optionsEn: Water-hammer speed always equals water sound speed regardless of the wall.
The Joukowsky increment is the absolute maximum pressure everywhere.
Pressure-wave speed depends jointly on water compressibility and radial pipe-wall compliance, so the sound speed in unconfined water is insufficient.
quiz.explanation: 壓力波速度由水的可壓縮性與管壁徑向柔度共同控制，不能直接使用自由水體的聲速。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Pressure-wave speed depends jointly on water compressibility and radial pipe-wall compliance, so the sound speed in unconfined water is insufficient. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 流體管壁耦合波速機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Fluid and wall wave speed mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「流體管壁耦合波速」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fluid and wall wave speed” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設水K=2.2 GPa、ρ=1000 kg/m³、鋼E=200 GPa、D=1 m、t=0.010 m，a=√[K/{ρ(1+KD/Et)}]=1023.5 m/s。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume water K=2.2 GPa, ρ=1000 kg/m³, steel E=200 GPa, D=1 m and t=0.010 m; a=√[K/{ρ(1+KD/Et)}]=1023.5 m/s. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以管材證明、壁厚檢查及支承配置建立參數範圍，對照經核准的小擾動壓力到時資料估算有效波速。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Build parameter ranges from material records, thickness inspection and restraint details, then compare effective speed with approved small-disturbance pressure arrival data.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設水K=2.2 GPa、ρ=1000 kg/m³、鋼E=200 GPa、D=1 m、t=0.010 m，a=√[K/{ρ(1+KD/Et)}]=1023.5 m/s。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume water K=2.2 GPa, ρ=1000 kg/m³, steel E=200 GPa, D=1 m and t=0.010 m; a=√[K/{ρ(1+KD/Et)}]=1023.5 m/s.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「流體管壁耦合波速機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Fluid and wall wave speed mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設水K=2.2 GPa、ρ=1000 kg/m³、鋼E=200 GPa、D=1 m、t=0.010 m，a=√[K/{ρ(1+KD/Et)}]=1023.5 m/s。
關閉時間增加一倍就一定讓全線峰值減半。
只要表壓小於零，就表示管內已形成蒸氣空穴。
optionsEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume water K=2.2 GPa, ρ=1000 kg/m³, steel E=200 GPa, D=1 m and t=0.010 m.
Doubling closure time always halves the peak everywhere in the main.
Any negative gauge pressure means a vapor cavity has formed.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設水K=2.2 GPa、ρ=1000 kg/m³、鋼E=200 GPa、D=1 m、t=0.010 m，a=√[K/{ρ(1+KD/Et)}]=1023.5 m/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume water K=2.2 GPa, ρ=1000 kg/m³, steel E=200 GPa, D=1 m and t=0.010 m; a=√[K/{ρ(1+KD/Et)}]=1023.5 m/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 流體管壁耦合波速機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Fluid and wall wave speed mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「流體管壁耦合波速」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Fluid and wall wave speed” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以管材證明、壁厚檢查及支承配置建立參數範圍，對照經核准的小擾動壓力到時資料估算有效波速。分別檢查溫度與含氣變化，避免只靠調整波速補償錯誤的管長。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Build parameter ranges from material records, thickness inspection and restraint details, then compare effective speed with approved small-disturbance pressure arrival data. Examine temperature and entrained-air changes separately so that speed adjustments do not conceal an incorrect pipe length. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：比較相同直徑下兩種壁厚的計算波速，再列出公式未涵蓋的約束與含氣條件；以多測點到時共同檢驗參數，不用單一峰值選定波速。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare two wall thicknesses at the same diameter and list omitted restraint and air conditions. Test the parameters using arrivals at multiple sensors rather than selecting speed from one peak.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把自由水聲速當成全線波速會錯估到時與反射疊加，可能把兩個壓力峰排成錯誤時序；過度調參仍可讓單點曲線看似吻合。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using free-water sound speed throughout the main distorts arrival times and reflection superposition, potentially ordering pressure peaks incorrectly. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以管材證明、壁厚檢查及支承配置建立參數範圍，對照經核准的小擾動壓力到時資料估算有效波速。分別檢查溫度與含氣變化，避免只靠調整波速補償錯誤的管長。
knowledge.textEn: Build parameter ranges from material records, thickness inspection and restraint details, then compare effective speed with approved small-disturbance pressure arrival data. Examine temperature and entrained-air changes separately so that speed adjustments do not conceal an incorrect pipe length.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 比較相同直徑下兩種壁厚的計算波速，再列出公式未涵蓋的約束與含氣條件；以多測點到時共同檢驗參數，不用單一峰值選定波速。
knowledge.textEn: Compare two wall thicknesses at the same diameter and list omitted restraint and air conditions. Test the parameters using arrivals at multiple sensors rather than selecting speed from one peak.

quiz.question: 要驗證「流體管壁耦合波速機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Fluid and wall wave speed mechanism and verification"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以管材證明、壁厚檢查及支承配置建立參數範圍，對照經核准的小擾動壓力到時資料估算有效波速。
計算曲線越平滑就表示模型越準確而且越安全。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Build parameter ranges from material records, thickness inspection and restraint details, then compare effective speed with approved small-disturbance pressure arrival data.
A smoother calculated trace necessarily means a more accurate and safer model.
quiz.explanation: 以管材證明、壁厚檢查及支承配置建立參數範圍，對照經核准的小擾動壓力到時資料估算有效波速。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Build parameter ranges from material records, thickness inspection and restraint details, then compare effective speed with approved small-disturbance pressure arrival data. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 流體管壁耦合波速機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Fluid and wall wave speed mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「流體管壁耦合波速」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Fluid and wall wave speed” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把自由水聲速當成全線波速會錯估到時與反射疊加，可能把兩個壓力峰排成錯誤時序；過度調參仍可讓單點曲線看似吻合。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using free-water sound speed throughout the main distorts arrival times and reflection superposition, potentially ordering pressure peaks incorrectly. Excessive calibration can still make one monitoring trace appear convincing. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：下式為忽略泊松與端部約束修正的簡化彈性薄壁關係，不能直接套用黏彈性塑膠管或有大氣囊的管路。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: It does not directly represent viscoelastic plastic pipes or large trapped-air pockets.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「水錘波速永遠等於水中聲速且與管壁無關。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Water-hammer speed always equals water sound speed regardless of the wall." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把自由水聲速當成全線波速會錯估到時與反射疊加，可能把兩個壓力峰排成錯誤時序；過度調參仍可讓單點曲線看似吻合。
knowledge.textEn: Using free-water sound speed throughout the main distorts arrival times and reflection superposition, potentially ordering pressure peaks incorrectly. Excessive calibration can still make one monitoring trace appear convincing.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「流體管壁耦合波速機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Fluid and wall wave speed mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
焦可夫斯基壓升就是全線的絕對最大壓力。
把自由水聲速當成全線波速會錯估到時與反射疊加，可能把兩個壓力峰排成錯誤時序；過度調參仍可讓單點曲線看似吻合。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
The Joukowsky increment is the absolute maximum pressure everywhere.
Using free-water sound speed throughout the main distorts arrival times and reflection superposition, potentially ordering pressure peaks incorrectly.
quiz.explanation: 把自由水聲速當成全線波速會錯估到時與反射疊加，可能把兩個壓力峰排成錯誤時序；過度調參仍可讓單點曲線看似吻合。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using free-water sound speed throughout the main distorts arrival times and reflection superposition, potentially ordering pressure peaks incorrectly. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
